name: Permission to Enter a Certain City

steps.name: Permission to Enter a Certain City (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Einst] in the "Guild Union", defeat [Mautu] in the "Hall of Rest" and [Evil Order] in the "Frozen World", then report to [Einst] in the "Guild Union".

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You're here. I thought someone as impatient as you would appreciate this news.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What news? Something good...?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The president has returned.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The president...?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Yes. President Dayna is back from her brief absence.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: As you know, President Dayna is the heart of the Guild Alliance and the master of the Storm Watchers Guild. It seems she's been following your exploits.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: She has instructed me to test whether you qualify to enter the Guild Alliance city.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So once I pass, I can go inside through that portal beside the Guild Alliance soldier?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That took forever. It feels like nearly ten years.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Ten years...? Quite the sense of humor you have.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The test is nothing elaborate. You simply need to clear several dungeons using your own skills.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Here it is, the note from the president... She wants you to visit the Hall of Rest and the Frozen World.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Good luck, then.

steps.name: Permission to Enter a Certain City (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Arborum] in the "Monster Tree Mountain Valley" and [Chloris] in the "Magic Academy Main Building", then report to [Einst] in the "Guild Union".

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (The president's note burned up on its own. That must mean the work there is finished.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Was it difficult?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was tough, but I managed. Is that the end of the test?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: It wouldn't be much of a test if it ended so quickly, would it?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I have another note from the president. I can promise you this: finish these places and you're done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do I go next?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Monster Tree Mountain Valley and the Magic Academy Main Building. Hmm. Why is the academy on a list of dungeons?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Well, never mind. Take care out there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

steps.name: Permission to Enter a Certain City (3)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Another note burning up by itself. Is that everything...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Well done. How did it go this time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About the same. It was tough, but I managed.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The test is complete. As promised, I grant you permission to enter the Guild Alliance city.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Tell Dame Lena Highren, and that settles it. You've done well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That was simpler than I expected.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You've already completed many requests for the Guild Alliance, whether you knew it or not. That's made things easier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go tell her I'm finished, then.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Looks like there's still plenty of time... Care for a beer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, thank you. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that you completed all of President Dayna's tests and now qualify to enter the Guild Alliance city.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I see. In a few days, you'll officially be allowed into Esnil, the Guild Alliance city.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Esnil is the other side of the Guild Alliance city. Once you encounter it, you'll discover another world.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: While Eastland's history has been one long series of battles, Freios has always been closer to the gods. That's part of why magic flourished here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Esnil...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: President Dayna is someone extraordinary, much like Her Majesty the Empress. Treat her with respect. She doesn't show herself to just anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person is she?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: That's not for me to explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll find out in time.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Good. Everyone should rest for now. I'll call when it's time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go easy on the drinking...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You're worrying over nothing. Even Sir Muller doesn't worry about my drinking...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you later.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Come to think of it, Her Majesty said it's been a long time since she last saw President Dayna... I wonder if the two of them will meet.
